versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.1 – Internal-only update; no user-facing or documentation changes.

- No file or documentation changes detected.
- Functionality, protocols, and guidance remain identical to previous version.

- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- No changes made to SKILL.md; the protocol, taxonomy, and operational guidance remain unchanged.
- No new features or updates—this is a housekeeping release focused on file cleanup.

Anti-hallucination-skill v1.0.1

- Initial public release of a comprehensive hallucination detection and mitigation protocol for OpenClaw agents
- Includes actionable triggers, taxonomy of hallucination types, and step-by-step self-check and grounding protocols
- Provides confidence calibration guidelines and guardrails for tool use to minimize ambigious or unverified claims
- Outlines multi-agent and solo verification methods, as well as continuous metacognitive review routines
- Supplies practical recovery and correction workflows for when hallucinations are detected
- Designed for integration into AGENTS.md and as a template for SKILL.md risk awareness sections
